package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// TestMigration019EmptySchemaUpDown keeps the rollback proof isolated from the
// shared public test schema. It applies the authoritative forward chain into
// an empty disposable schema, then proves that an unused 019 can return to
// the exact post-018 shape without dropping the dense 017 proof/outcome FKs.
func TestMigration019EmptySchemaUpDown(t *testing.T) {
	pool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn, err := pool.Acquire(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer conn.Release()

	schema := "teacher_s5_migration_" + strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")
	quotedSchema := pgx.Identifier{schema}.Sanitize()
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if pool != nil && schema != "" {
			// t.Cleanup runs after this function returns, while the deferred
			// conn.Release has already returned the acquired connection to the
			// pool. Clean up through the pool so the migration harness never
			// dereferences a released connection.
			_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP SCHEMA "+quotedSchema+" CASCADE")
		}
	})
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, "SET search_path TO "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	upPaths, err := migrationUpPathsThrough(root, 19)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range upPaths {
		sql, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, readErr, path)
		_, execErr := conn.Exec(ctx, string(sql))
		require.NoError(t, execErr, path)
	}

	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db", "migrations", "019_teacher_onboarding_unified_coordinator.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, string(down))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, relation := range []string{"teacher_onboarding_turn", "teacher_onboarding_interaction"} {
		var exists bool
		require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass($1) IS NOT NULL`, relation).Scan(&exists))
		require.False(t, exists, relation)
	}
	var coordinatorColumn bool
	require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='teacher_dialog_job' AND column_name='coordinator_mode'
)`).Scan(&coordinatorColumn))
	require.False(t, coordinatorColumn)
	for _, name := range []string{"teacher_dialog_job_proof_fk", "teacher_dialog_job_outcome_fk"} {
		var exists bool
		require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
  WHERE connamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND conname=$1
)`, name).Scan(&exists))
		require.True(t, exists, fmt.Sprintf("post-017 FK %s must survive a 019-only rollback", name))
	}
}

func TestMigration019DiscoveryIgnoresAppleDoubleSidecars(t *testing.T) {
	require.False(t, migration019MigrationFileAllowed("._019_teacher_onboarding_unified_coordinator.up.sql"))
	require.True(t, migration019MigrationFileAllowed("019_teacher_onboarding_unified_coordinator.up.sql"))
	paths, err := migrationUpPathsThrough(migration019RepositoryRoot(t), 19)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range paths {
		require.LessOrEqual(t, migrationNumber(t, filepath.Base(path)), 19, "historical 019 rollback proof must not apply a later migration")
	}
}

func migration019UpPaths(root string) ([]string, error) {
	return migrationUpPathsThrough(root, int(^uint(0)>>1))
}

func migrationUpPathsThrough(root string, maximum int) ([]string, error) {
	paths, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "db", "migrations", "*.up.sql"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	filtered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
	for _, path := range paths {
		name := filepath.Base(path)
		if migration019MigrationFileAllowed(name) && migrationNumberValue(name) <= maximum {
			filtered = append(filtered, path)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(filtered)
	return filtered, nil
}

func migrationNumber(t *testing.T, name string) int {
	t.Helper()
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.SplitN(name, "_", 2)[0])
	require.NoError(t, err, name)
	return value
}

func migrationNumberValue(name string) int {
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.SplitN(name, "_", 2)[0])
	if err != nil {
		return int(^uint(0) >> 1)
	}
	return value
}

func migration019MigrationFileAllowed(name string) bool {
	return strings.HasSuffix(name, ".up.sql") && !strings.HasPrefix(name, "._")
}

func migration019RepositoryRoot(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	_, current, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	require.True(t, ok)
	return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(current), "../../../../"))
}
